mechanics.claim: Thick Skin stores a portion of post-mitigation damage taken as grey health rather than reducing incoming damage directly.
mechanics.quote: '''Tahm Kench''' stores a portion of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} he takes as [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] on his [[health bar]]

mechanics.claim: The stored damage percentage is increased while at least 2 enemy champions (dead or alive) are within sight/visible range.
mechanics.quote: increased while there are at least 2 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions either dead or alive

mechanics.claim: Because grey health converts all post-mitigation damage, Thick Skin effectively grants a form of true damage mitigation.
mechanics.quote: ''Grey health'' converts all post-mitigation damage, ''Thick Skin'' effectively grants ''Tahm Kench'' a form of {{as|true damage}} mitigation.

mechanics.claim: Grey health decays into a heal only while Thick Skin is off cooldown and after 4 seconds without taking damage.
mechanics.quote: While ''Thick Skin'' is not on cooldown, and after 4 seconds without taking damage, '''Tahm Kench''' rapidly consumes his [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] to restore

mechanics.claim: The active converts Tahm Kench's current grey health into a shield lasting a fixed duration, and the E cooldown starts upon that shield's destruction or expiration.
mechanics.quote: '''Tahm Kench''' converts his current [[Health#Grey health|grey health]] into a {{tip|shield}} that lasts for {{fd|2.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Both the grey-health heal and the shield are boosted by effects that increase healing and shielding power, potentially exceeding normal grey-health/shield caps.
mechanics.quote: ''Thick Skin'' shield value and ''grey health'' percentage heal are both boosted by effects that increase heal and shield power.
